items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: Jimmy Blythe... asked me if I would use this washboard in Jasper's place... before Jasper started it

ctx.x: Great clarinet player. And then Jasper Taylor had produced the washboard on records at that particular time. And so Jasper's, and he went away on a big job. And Jimmy O'Brien, Jimmy Blythe was such close friends of mine, and he asked me if I would use this washboard in Jasper's place, because he knowed I was playing washboard as a novelty instrument all the time before Jasper started it. But I hadn't become popular like that.
